Using data from shiny applications that I made, I was able to take stats from a game of the Sewanee men's soccer team. The data was able to develop an idea about the playstyle of the team and how they can improve their approach in the future. The Sewanee men's soccer team holds so much promise and analyzing their areas of growth could allow for more success in upcoming seasons.
